verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say it sends and receives money over ACH through its APIs. It also has a webhook events page and sandbox simulation endpoints for payment clearing. Everything beyond basic ACH capability is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented ACH credit vs debit origination, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class API objects, ACH-specific webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can originate ACH through the API — credits and debits, same-day windows, and the unhappy paths (returns, NOCs, reversals) modeled as first-class objects with webhooks

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments, with settlement-level transaction visibility.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
Sandbox exposes a set of simulation-specific endpoints
